what: 2026-10-19: the release of main e0d75d8 (#176) by the release operator before the 10:00 KST window; the backup checks of the #173 fix; the nightly backup alerts of the ops watch.

contains: #176 a lapsed Claude subscription login waits for the renewed login instead of blocking the daily video; an episode blocked as model_auth goes back to the stage of its model call
release.why_before_the_window: the 10/19 AM video job 78fa991c stopped at 07:05 KST as blocked/model_auth (the claude-runtime login had lapsed at 00:01 KST; the owner logged in again at 08:37). The owner asked through the video session to release as soon as it was safe.
release.render_check: 1aceeb8 -> e0d75d8 changed deploy/release.py, video/analytics_contracts.py, video/runner.py and video/store.py; render_changes [] and operator files [], so VIDEO_RENDER_COMMIT=1aceeb8 and quant-company-render:11 stay valid
release.ci: the first main run failed one test unrelated to #176 (test_codex_runtime.py::test_briefing_has_its_own_single_slot_and_preserves_other_lanes: its calls() helper read calls.jsonl while the fake codex was still appending, JSONDecodeError on a partial line; 2887 passed). The failed job was rerun and passed at 09:15 KST; the release started only after that.
release.build: 631 s for all six images (08:42-08:53 KST). The nightly storage cleanup prunes build cache unused for 24 hours (docker buildx prune --filter until=24h), and the previous build was on 10/16, so the dependency layers were rebuilt. Builds within a day of the previous one still take about a minute.

values.RELEASE_AUTO_ENABLED: paused during the release, then true

release.order: the deploy/release.json groups in their own order; #176 changes no value that another service checks
release.plan: 17 services, every one with an exact rollback
release.effects: 5 outbox rows delivered during the release; no news review went stale
release.video: the new video-worker moved the AM job from blocked to queued at 09:27:33. The plan request was asked again under its 07:05 request ID; claude-runtime started an Opus 5.5 turn at 09:27:35 with the renewed login and the plan completed at 09:39:57, the review at 09:52:57, and the revision began at 09:53. The blocked incident closed at 09:29; video_late stays open until delivery.

backup_checks_after_173.result: each check during the backup reported waiting_for_lock and the next one up_to_date; no drift alert

kst.10/17: 03:13 dispatch fallback notice, 03:17 down:fleet (12 services, critical), 03:18 down:worker (critical)

backup_alerts_of_the_ops_watch.cause: state_backup.py stops the 12 APP_SERVICES for the database dump and starts them again before it uploads (about 4-5 minutes). The probe saw dispatch stopped and posted its direct fallback notice; the in-app watch, ticking again once dispatch was back, read the last snapshot with 12 stopped services and announced down:fleet with the owner mentioned.
backup_alerts_of_the_ops_watch.fix: the probe records the backup's services while quant-company-backup.service is activating, and the watch and the fallback treat them as a deploy window; postgres and other services still alert
